descriptionMd:
LUN4R CTF 2026 is a National Level Capture The Flag competition organized by ROOT RIET, the cybersecurity community of Rajadhani Institute of Engineering and Technology (RIET), Thiruvananthapuram.

THE NIGHT HIDES THE FLAG.

ROUND 1 — ONLINE QUALIFIERS
20 September 2026 | 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM IST
A 12-hour online CTF featuring 24 challenges across Web, Crypto, Pwn, Forensics, Misc, Reverse Engineering, and OSINT.

The top 30 teams will qualify for the offline finals.

ROUND 2 — OFFLINE FINALS
4 October 2026 | RIET, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala

PRIZES
1st — ₹50,000
2nd — ₹30,000
3rd — ₹20,000
Plus additional vouchers and rewards.

LUN4R CTF 2026 is supported by our sponsors and partners, whose contributions help us build a stronger cybersecurity community and competitive platform.
Contact: [phone redacted] | [phone redacted]

descriptionMd:
BCS CTF will be organized as an online cyber competition under BCS ICT Fest 2026. It is designed to encourage ethical hacking, cybersecurity learning, teamwork and practical problem-solving.

Event hosted by: Bangladesh Computer Society (BCS)

discord: https://discord.gg/qhaYDaJE26

prize.text:
Top 10 international teams will receive a complimentary ticket valued at USD 400 to attend BCS ICT Fest 2026 in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

The top 3 professional teams from Bangladesh will be selected for prizes.

The top 3 student teams from Bangladesh will be selected for prizes.

Prize money will be announced later.

Top 50 teams from Bangladesh will receive a complimentary ticket to attend BCS ICT Fest 2026 in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

Certificates & Special Rewards:

Every participating team will receive a digital certificate.

Additional giveaways and first-blood prizes for participants will be announced later.
